claimBoundary: Descriptive Git-history and frozen-index audit for the already observed Bat Round 12 auxiliary miss. It does not estimate a causal probability, does not execute an Agent, and supports no correctness, Token, tool-call, or wall-time claim.

method.historyScope: Commits reachable from the frozen route commit
method.countRule: Count unique commit hashes returned by git log --format=%H -- <path>, then intersect the three path-specific sets.
method.indexObservation: The frozen Palace index contains a direct implementation/verification relation, but no relation from CHANGELOG.md to either core path.

decision.reason: The frozen task and index strongly identify the implementation/test pair but do not provide a discriminative changelog signal. A global bugfix-to-changelog rule would be a disclosed-target policy override rather than an evidence-based route repair.
